_README: This file is a SHOPPING LIST, not a source of truth.
It records which official documents the app is meant to serve and where they
were published. It contains NO regulation text and NO clause numbers.
SCOPE: GDCR is primary. role=primary documents are what this tool answers from
for Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar feasibility work. role=supporting documents (NBC)
are back-end reference, consulted where GDCR points to them or is silent.
role=phase2 needs spatial data, not clause ingestion.
The truth always comes from the ingested PDF itself: tools/ingest.py reads the
real file, extracts verbatim text page by page, and records a sha256 of the
exact file it read. If a document is not ingested, the app shows it as NOT
LOADED and refuses to answer from it rather than guessing.
url_reachable=false means the build sandbox could not reach that host (blocked
by egress policy), so the URL came from a web search and was NOT opened or
confirmed. Verify each URL, and verify you have the CURRENT amendment.
_copyright_notice: CGDCR and Development Plan documents are Government of Gujarat notifications,
The National Building Code of India 2016 is copyright Bureau of Indian
Standards and is SOLD, not freely licensed. Obtain a licensed copy. Do NOT
commit extracted NBC full text to a public repository — keep corpus/docs/nbc-*
out of version control or keep the repository private. See corpus/.gitignore.
